post_eval: tools/ssenv python -m ss_coherentgs.evaluate --run <run> --split test   # paper's masked metrics (alpha < 1e-3 -> white in both); writes <run>/test_masked.json

baseline.note: Optional: gsplat from the same per-pixel (unaligned mono-depth) init; evaluate masked with `python -m ss_coherentgs.evaluate --run <gsplat run> --mask-run <coherentgs run>` (the paper masks every method with CoherentGS's alpha). Paper's 3DGS row (14.99) is vanilla 3DGS from its own init, so this is only indicative.

llff-fewview3-cgs._doc: CoherentGS 3-view LLFF (official readLLFFInfo): official images_8 PNGs (504x378, pixel-identical to nerf_llff_data/images_8), official poses_bounds frame (fix_rotation, translations x 1/(0.75 min bound)), focal = f/8, centred principal point; test = every 8th sorted image, train = round(linspace) 3 of the rest (same names as llff-fewview3-r8), val = rest. points.npz = one point per training pixel (unaligned Depth-Anything depth after the official bilateral filtering), coherentgs.npz = depth-layer masks (5 ch), FlowFormer++ flows + consistency weights from the author-processed archive llff_sparse.zip (sha256 84caaa59...). Built by reproductions/coherentgs/tools/prepare_cgs_llff.py (PYTHONPATH=~/models/coherentgs/pylib for sklearn); NOT rebuildable by bench.py prepare.

notes: Must keep all 571,536 per-pixel points (--num-gaussians >= that) and use --recipe splatstudio (3dgs recipe kNN init ~20 GB at 571k points; scales are overwritten by the plugin). --steps 13000 = official iterations 7001-20000; the 1000 alignment iterations run inside density.initialize. Data root is read from ss-train --data (or COHERENTGS_DATA). Paper numbers are masked averages: compare test_masked.json masked_white with 20.33/0.725/0.180, and report unmasked ss-eval numbers alongside.
